correctness.rationale: Direct exact conditional Bernoulli-tail formula for deterministic Gaussian scores. Two independent Poisson upper/lower extreme processes and continuously marked cross-pairs give the limiting distribution. Exact mean candidate count (1+t)e^t and Bernoulli minimum construction ensure local finiteness. Geometric first-edge domination and a uniform second-moment Gaussian order-statistic spacing bound prove uniform integrability, yielding E[a_n L_n]→E D_p. Euclidean projection radial normalization gives the sharp √2 coefficient. Analytic calculations justify p↓0 logarithmic and p↑1 linear endpoint limits. 1,096 exact finite-graph cases and seeded PPP truncation tests passed; finite checks are nonproof support.

value.rationale: The result resolves a canonical geometric observable of the random symmetric edge polytopes introduced in existing research, rather than a chosen small instance. It specifies an entire nondegenerate loss distribution, a strict positive mean-width coefficient, and two sharply distinct edge-density endpoint asymptotics. The Bernoulli-marked Poisson limit quantitatively separates the metric question from the established facet-count theory and deterministic sparse-deletion bounds. The theorem has an infinite parameter regime and naturally sharp scaling.
